ai_content.intro: استمتع بمشاهدة فيلم Semper Fi (2001) مترجم بجودة عالية على توميتو.
ai_content.desc_ar: استمتع بمشاهدة فيلم سمبر فاي مترجم بجودة عالية.
ai_content.desc_en: Cliff Truckee refuses a privileged start in life at a top college while other young men are enlisting. On the bus out of Chicago he meets a girl on her way to join the Marines, falls in love and decides to do the same. Paris Island is physically tough, but it is troubles that are brought from home that endanger some recruits success, in an extreme case even a life. Team bonding is changing Cliff, but so can a broken heart.
